title: Adhyaya 1: Samanvaya (Harmonization of Scripture)
summary: Demonstrates that all Upanishadic passages harmoniously reveal Brahman as the supreme cause and reality.
ai_summary: Badarayana establishes that Brahman is the sole material and efficient cause of the universe through rigorous textual synthesis.

verses.translation: Now, therefore, the inquiry into Brahman begins.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The word 'atha' (now) implies the antecedent qualification: the fourfold spiritual discipline (Sadhana Chatushtaya). 'Atah' (therefore) indicates that ephemeral ritual fruits do not satisfy the soul; eternal Brahman alone must be investigated.

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: Inquiry into Brahman directly follows the understanding of ritual karma (Dharmajijnasa), revealing the Supreme Person as the inner ruler of all.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: अब साधन-चतुष्टय की प्राप्ति के पश्चात् नित्य-मुक्त परब्रह्म की जिज्ञासा प्रारंभ की जाती है।

verses.translation: From which proceed the origin, sustenance, and dissolution of this universe.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Brahman is defined as the ground of cosmic projection, preservation, and absorption (Tatastha Lakshana), corresponding to Taittiriya Upanishad 3.1.

layers.author: madhvacharya
layers.content: Lord Narayana alone is the sovereign eightfold cause of creation, preservation, destruction, control, knowledge, ignorance, bondage, and release.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: जिससे इस समस्त जगत की उत्पत्ति, स्थिति और प्रलय होता है, वही परब्रह्म है।

verses.translation: Because the scripture (Veda) is the sole valid means of knowing Brahman, and because Brahman is the author of scripture.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Sensory perception and dry inference cannot grasp transcendental Brahman; the sacred word (Shabda Pramana) alone reveals the Infinite.

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: शास्त्र ही परब्रह्म का प्रामाणिक ज्ञान कराने वाला एकमात्र साधन है।

verses.translation: But that Brahman is known through the complete harmony of all Vedantic passages.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Every Upanishadic declaration, whether asserting existence, consciousness, or bliss, converges unswervingly on the non-dual Self.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: समस्त वेदान्त वाक्यों का एकमत समन्वय केवल परब्रह्म में ही सिद्ध होता है।

verses.translation: Because seeing (thinking/willing) is attributed to the Cause in scripture, the insentient Pradhana of Sankhya is not that Cause.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Scripture declares 'Tadaikshata' (It willed/saw). Seeing is an act of pure consciousness, refuting the unconscious material cause of the Sankhya school.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: सृष्टि से पूर्व ईक्षण (संकल्प) चेतन का ही धर्म है, अतः जड़ प्रकृति जगत का मूल कारण नहीं हो सकती।
